content.short: Catsky AI is a Cardano token project combining cat memes, Web3, AI tools, NFTs, and community culture.
content.description: Catsky AI is a Cardano native token project focused on combining Web3, artificial intelligence, and community culture. The project uses cat meme branding while aiming to build tools, services, and applications that solve Web3 problems and encourage adoption of crypto and AI technology. Its thesis is that humans and AI can create value together, while NFTs and tokens help capture that value and incentivize participation. Catsky AI evolved from a cat-themed meme token into a broader AI-focused community project.
